pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal regions on the flank exhibiting sharp edge gradients and high contrast; patches on the upper dorsal and cervical regions are significantly obscured by extensive greyish textural disruption.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Negative-space network of off-white pathways forming distinct 3-way and 4-way junction nodes; pathway thickness is relatively uniform on the flank but becomes thin and discontinuous near the dorsal ridge due to skin lesions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette visible along the cervical mane, though intermittently occluded by avian clusters.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Extensive zones of greyish, hyper-keratotic textural disruption and loss of standard pigment pattern along the upper cervical and dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple large, raised, greyish-white nodules and prominent skin lesions are visible on the lower chest and ventral flank regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a high-density cluster of approximately 18 yellow-billed oxpeckers (Buphagus africanus) primarily localized to the dorsal ridge and upper neck area.
